cleanRoom.source: Repo-owned Excel/MSForms fixture input generated through public Excel/VBIDE automation and driven with public Windows input.
cleanRoom.prohibited: No Office internals, decompilation, disassembly, non-public source, or OxForms output comparison.

notes: YieldButton fills the form client area so a single window-centre click always lands on it; no screenshot anchor is needed.

Control fonts are intentionally not declared/applied: this is a DoEvents reentrancy/timing oracle, not a text-metrics oracle (see the W006 nested-modal fixture README for why design-time VBIDE fonts are avoided).
